thread:
alex: Hey — I opened a PR that touches runtime config and the infra lib. CODEOWNERS currently lists both teams, but neither has clear final say. Can someone advise the correct merge path or who to ping for approval? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842

sam: quick glance — this hits `serving/runtime/config` and `infra/deploy`. Usually we ping eng-runtime and eng-platform. But if owners overlap in CODEOWNERS, we sometimes route to a single team lead.

maria: paste of relevant CODEOWNERS lines so you can see overlap:
```
# in repo root .github/CODEOWNERS
serving/runtime/* @eng-runtime/owners
infra/deploy/* @eng-platform/infra-owners
serving/* @eng-runtime/owners @eng-platform/infra-owners
```

jen: hmm. That middle line is the problem — it lists both. For smaller PRs we ask one team to take primary review and the other to do a quick ack. This change is ~40 lines, config tweaks + a small helper. I'd suggest eng-runtime takes primary, eng-platform quick-ack.

luis: +1 to jen. Also: alex, can you split the PR into two commits (config vs helper) and mark the helper commit as NON-BREAKING so eng-platform can fast-ack? Saves time for a release window.

alex: I can split it. timeline: want to merge before Thursday release window. Who should I explicitly @mention to get the primary review?

sam: ping @maria for eng-runtime primary. For eng-platform ack, ping @luis or @jen. If you want on-call-style fast turnarounds, route to #eng-oncall and add the label `merge-hotpath` so infra knows it's release-critical.

maria: I can take primary review if you split commits. I'll aim for EOD today. Please include a short rationale in the PR description about why the config change is safe (eg: default unchanged).

opt-bot: automated: PR 842 flagged for multi-team CODEOWNERS. Suggested route: primary=@eng-runtime/owners secondary=@eng-platform/infra-owners. Add label `multi-team-review` to proceed.

alex: done — split commits, added description and labels `multi-team-review` `release-candidate`. Mentioned @maria and @jen in PR body. Thanks all.

jen: I'm happy to do the quick ack once maria's changes land. If anything blocks eng-platform approvals (acl or infra change), I'll escalate to the weekly approvals rotation to avoid delays.

maria: review posted with one small nits and one question about a default value — nothing blocking.

alex: addressed nit and replied to question. Can someone give a +1 from eng-platform when convenient?

luis: +1 from eng-platform. Verified deploy config looks safe.

alex: thanks everyone — merging after CI passes. Will follow up if the release pipeline complains. :+1:
